preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Contract must have ETH balance (from token swap fees or direct transfers)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setOperationsAddress() to set the operations address to a malicious contract. Then trigger swapBack() (via trading or forceSwapBack()) to execute the low-level call that sends all contract ETH to the malicious contract. The malicious contract should have a fallback/receive function that captures the ETH and transfers it to the attacker.
